CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW ptah_test.mv_after REFRESH AFTER 30 MINUTE (`c` UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192 DEFINER = ptah_user SQL SECURITY DEFINER AS SELECT count() AS c FROM ptah_test.src
